"""Model of a behavior-level alternative to the fixed-offset tests."""

from comet.inventory import build_inventory


def test_inventory_modes_select_their_writer_output() -> None:
    """Require each inventory mode to produce its documented writer output."""
    inventory = build_inventory("node_local")
    assert inventory.mode_output("node_local") == inventory.writer_output()
    assert inventory.unmapped_mode() is None


def test_unknown_mode_reports_a_public_error() -> None:
    """Require an unknown mode to produce the documented error contract."""
    try:
        build_inventory("unknown_mode")
    except KeyError as error:
        assert "unknown_mode" in str(error)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("an unknown mode must raise a public error")
